hints.title: Multi-Table Left Joins
hints.text: Join salesperson to customer on salesperson id, and join customer to sales on customer id using left joins to preserve inactive salespersons.

hints.title: Salesperson Grouping
hints.text: Group by salesperson id and salesperson name.

hints.title: Null Coalescing Total
hints.text: Calculate sum of price, wrapping with coalesce to substitute 0 for salespersons without transactions.

hints.title: Left Join Aggregation Query Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
select
    sp.salesperson_id,
    sp.name,
    coalesce(sum(s.price), 0) as total
from Salesperson sp
left join Customer c on sp.salesperson_id = c.salesperson_id
left join Sales s on c.customer_id = s.customer_id
group by sp.salesperson_id, sp.name;
```

complexity.notes: Left hash joins followed by group by aggregation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subquery per salesperson produces quadratic scan overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Accumulator table tracks sums per salesperson.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrates multi-table left joins with proper null handling.
